name: rova-app
description: Rova Workflow Builder — visual workflow automation with a node-based editor and plugin integrations

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names app,inngest --prefix-colors blue,magenta "bun run dev:app" "bun run dev:inngest"
scripts.example:library-trigger: sh -c 'export INNGEST_BASE_URL=${INNGEST_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8389} APP_PORT=${PORT:-4018}; bun run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names app,inngest --prefix-colors blue,magenta "PORT=$APP_PORT INNGEST_BASE_URL=$INNGEST_BASE_URL bun run examples/library-trigger.ts" "if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/inngest ]; then until curl -sSf http://localhost:$APP_PORT/api/inngest >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; cd examples && DO_NOT_TRACK=1 ../node_modules/.bin/inngest dev --no-discovery -u http://localhost:$APP_PORT/api/inngest -p 8389 --connect-gateway-port 8391 --connect-gateway-grpc-port 50064 --connect-executor-grpc-port 50065 --persist; else echo \"[inngest] inngest-cli is not installed; skipping local Inngest dev server\"; fi"'
scripts.dev:inngest: sh -c 'if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/inngest ]; then until curl -sSf http://localhost:4017/api/inngest >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; DO_NOT_TRACK=1 ./node_modules/.bin/inngest dev --no-discovery -u http://localhost:4017/api/inngest -p 8388 --connect-gateway-port 8390 --connect-gateway-grpc-port 50062 --connect-executor-grpc-port 50063 --persist; else echo "[inngest] inngest-cli is not installed; skipping local Inngest dev server"; fi'
scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run build:plugins && bun run build:client
